subject: Quick thought on the Mueller location site for River Rock Dental
body: Hi River Rock Dental Team, I live in Austin and often look at local neighborhood practices. While checking out your Mueller clinic page for preventive and cosmetic dentistry, I noticed that the mobile view could benefit from a more prominent click-to-call button and integrated appointment booking right in the header to better capture busy working professionals. I went ahead and built a clean, fast-loading prototype for your Mueller location that adds those features, along with highlighted review badges to build instant trust. You can take a look at the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b5fffb62edcb-0xd339331fdb965f0.vercel.app. If you like the layout or want me to adjust anything specific, just let me know and I'd be happy to send over the code or chat for a few minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current site!
key_improvements: Added prominent click-to-call phone numbers for mobile visitors
Enhanced trust signals with visible review badges in the header
Streamlined the booking and appointment layout for faster conversion
